svg.aria-label: A vendor task became a daily LLM job.
svg.title: A vendor task became a daily LLM job.

svg.aria-label: A daily scheduled job samples job postings from the warehouse for three markets, extracts locations with gpt-4o-mini, classifies them with rules plus TF-IDF, matches them with a geocoder and libpostal, and publishes results for precision and recall tracking.
